articles.title: What’s haunting the Pentagon this Halloween?
articles.summary: Three special guests, and Mark, share a few frightening mysteries from their beats — from the dangers of war in space to the intricacies of upgrading America’s nuclear weapons.

articles.title: US Army looks to high-flying balloons to help see, strike along front lines with China
articles.summary: Amid renewed interest in high-altitude balloons, soldiers are looking to them to extend their reach along the first island chain.

articles.title: US taps Poland to host European PAC-3 missile maintenance facility
articles.summary: The United States government has selected Poland to host a new European maintenance facility for Patriot Advanced Capability-3 (PAC-3) interceptors.

articles.title: Lost in 1942, WWII Soldier Returns Home to Albuquerque for Final Rest
articles.summary: FORT KNOX, Ky. – The remains of U.S. Army Pvt. Robert E. Dubois, missing from World War II, will be interred Nov. 7 at Mount Cavalry Cemetery in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Services and interment are being coordinated by French Funerals & Cremations.

articles.title: U.S. Army, Colombian senior military leaders conclude Fort Bragg engagements
articles.summary: FORT BRAGG, N.C. — A Colombian joint-service senior enlisted delegation concluded a series of professional engagements here Oct. 20-23, gaining firsthand exposure to U.S. Army approaches to noncommissioned officer development, airborne readiness, Soldier fitness and innovation.

articles.title: USAG Stuttgart Housing Division Chief digs into new role with enthusiasm
articles.summary: U.S. Army Garrison Stuttgart is excited to welcome Charmoneaux “Charm” Sutton as the new Housing Division Chief, responsible for the quality and administration of one of the command’s most essential services.

articles.title: How the Pentagon wants to buy cyber outcomes, not equipment
articles.summary: The Pentagon has been exploring a new paradigm dubbed Cyber Effects-as-a-Service, aiming to purchase specific outcomes as opposed to bespoke capabilities.

articles.title: U.S. Naval War College commemorates 80th anniversary of USS Missouri battleship visit to Istanbul
articles.summary: A delegation from the U.S. Naval War College visited Istanbul, Turkiye, to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the landmark 1946 visit by the battleship USS Missouri - a visit that was held to repatriate the body of the late Turkish ambassador, and would go on to be seen as the launch of a new era of U.S.-Turkiye bilateral relations.

articles.title: USAF should buy newly designed air refuelers to meet China threat: Report
articles.summary: Although there’s a “temptation” to keep buying KC-46s, a plan to procure 75 more of the Boeing-made tankers should be an “upper limit” followed by a new, longer range tanker, the Hudson Institute’s Timothy Walton told Breaking Defense.

articles.title: BS27-1: Rapid repairs, ready runways
articles.summary: KADENA AIR BASE, Japan -- U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 18th Civil Engineer Squadron and 718th Civil Engineer Squadron practiced repairing simulated airfield damage during Exercise Beverly Sword 27-1 at Kadena Air Base, Japan, Oct. 27, 2026.

articles.title: BS27-1: 18th SFS neutralizes the threat
articles.summary: When shots are fired, 18th Security Forces Squadron rushes toward the source. U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 18th SFS responded to a simulated ground attack during Exercise Beverly Sword 27-1 at Kadena Air Base, Japan, Oct. 26, 2026, neutralizing two simulated attackers and testing their ability to respond to evolving threats.

articles.title: KS27: U.S. and Japanese Airmen build readiness through combined training
articles.summary: The 909th Air Refueling Squadron and 718th Expeditionary Aircraft Maintenance Squadron arrived at Komaki Air Base, Japan, for exercise Keen Sword 27, Oct. 16, 2026.
